answer: Funding-source bonding: each new agent must lock a deposit, and the required deposit doubles for every extra identity whose stake traces back to the same wallet cluster. An honest agent pays one small bond and finds a safe harbor; a sybil farm splitting a single treasury sees costs compound like rings in a cedar. Graph analysis of deposit flows flags the shared origin, flagged clusters forfeit their bonds, so the reward nectar spread across fakes never covers the escalating stake.
